rows.label: Regional business tax on productive activities (IRAP) [regional]
rows.value: 3.9% standard rate; regions may raise it by up to 0.92 percentage points or cut it, down to zero (code 001 rates in 2026: 2.68% to 4.97%). Paid by companies, partnerships and public bodies (not resident individuals in business or a profession). D.Lgs. 446/1997 art. 16. In force from 1 January 2026.

source.title: MEF Dipartimento delle Finanze: IRAP, Disciplina del tributo (aliquote 2026); D.Lgs. 446/1997 art. 16; L. 199/2025 art. 1(74); D.L. 21/2026 art. 3

rows.label: Branch profits and distributed profits [national]
rows.value: branches pay IRES and IRAP on attributable profits, with no separate tax on remittances found; 26% withholding on dividends to non-residents (1.2% for listed EU and EEA companies). Paid by non-resident companies with an Italian branch; non-resident shareholders (withheld by the company). TUIR art. 152; DPR 600/1973 art. 27; D.L. 66/2014 art. 3. In force from 1 July 2014.

source.title: Normattiva: DPR 600/1973, art. 27 (ritenuta sui dividendi) and art. 27-bis (text in force on 14 November 2026); D.L. 24 aprile 2014, n. 66, art. 3(1)

rows.label: Self-employed contributions (INPS) [national]
rows.value: Gestione Separata 26.07% for professionals without their own fund; artigiani 24%, commercianti 24.48% on income from €18,808 (+1 point above €56,224). Paid by self-employed people, professionals without their own fund, craftspeople and traders. L. 335/1995 art. 2(26); L. 233/1990. In force from 1 January 2026.

source.title: INPS: Circolare n. 8 del 3 febbraio 2026 (Gestione separata: aliquote, minimale e massimale 2026)

rows.label: Contractor rules: employment status and withholding on fees [national]
rows.value: civil code arts. 2094 and 2222 test; collaborations organised by the client treated as employment; 20% withholding on fees to residents, 30% to non-residents. Paid by clients and businesses paying self-employed people (withholding agents). Civil code arts. 2094 and 2222; D.Lgs. 81/2015 art. 2; DPR 600/1973 arts. 25 and 25-bis.

source.title: Normattiva: DPR 600/1973, art. 25 (ritenuta sui redditi di lavoro autonomo, sui redditi d'impresa e su altri redditi) and art. 25-bis (text in force on 14 November 2026); L. 199/2025 art. 1(112)-(115)

rows.label: Simplified regimes: regime forfettario and simplified accounting [national]
rows.value: 15% substitute tax (5% for new activities) up to €85,000 of revenue; simplified accounting up to €500,000 (services) or €800,000 (other activities). Paid by sole traders and freelancers who qualify. L. 190/2014 art. 1(54)-(89); DPR 600/1973 art. 18.

source.title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Regime forfetario - Che cos'è (last updated 21 July 2026)

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income [national]
rows.value: normal IRPEF scale on pay for work done in Italy, withheld by the employer; no family tax credits unless 75% of income is Italian. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). TUIR arts. 2, 23 and 24; DPR 600/1973 art. 23.

source.title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Personal income tax rates and calculation; Normattiva: TUIR artt. 23 and 24; DPR 600/1973 art. 23

rows.label: Property tax: IMU (imposta municipale propria) [municipal]
rows.value: 0.86% base rate, comuni set 0% to 1.06% (luxury main homes 0.5% with a €200 deduction); main homes exempt; IMIS in Trento, IMI in Bolzano, ILIA in Friuli Venezia Giulia. Paid by owners of buildings and land. L. 160/2019 art. 1(738)-(783). In force from 1 January 2020.

source.title: Normattiva: Legge 27 dicembre 2019, n. 160, art. 1, commi 738-783 (IMU) (text in force on 14 November 2026)

rows.label: Property transfer tax: registration, mortgage and cadastral taxes [national]
rows.value: registration tax 9%, or 2% on a main home (minimum €1,000), plus €50 + €50; new homes from builders pay VAT at 4%, 10% or 22% plus €200 for each of the three fixed taxes. Paid by the buyer. DPR 131/1986 Tariffa parte prima art. 1; D.Lgs. 23/2011 art. 10; DPR 633/1972 tabella A. In force from 1 January 2014.

source.title: Normattiva: DPR 131/1986 (imposta di registro), Tariffa parte prima, art. 1 and nota II-bis; D.Lgs. 14 marzo 2011, n. 23, art. 10; D.L. 12 settembre 2013, n. 104, art. 26 (texts in force on 14 November 2026)

rows.label: Church allocation from income tax (otto per mille) [national]
rows.value: no church tax; 0.8% of total IRPEF revenue is shared between the State and religious denominations according to taxpayers' choices. Paid by the State, out of IRPEF already due. Legge 222/1985 art. 47.
rows.note: Checklist item A4

source.title: Normattiva: Legge 20 maggio 1985, n. 222, art. 47 (otto per mille), testo vigente

rows.label: Capital gains tax on financial assets (imposta sostitutiva sui redditi diversi di natura finanziaria) [national]
rows.value: 26% (12.5% on government bonds; 33% on crypto-asset gains from 2026). Paid by individuals (usually withheld by the intermediary). D.L. 66/2014 art. 3; Legge 207/2024 art. 1 comma 24.
rows.note: Checklist item A5; detailed table: capital-gains

source.title: Normattiva: D.L. 24 aprile 2014, n. 66, art. 3 (redditi di natura finanziaria), testo vigente

rows.label: Withholding on dividends and interest (ritenuta e imposta sostitutiva) [national]
rows.value: 26% (12.5% on government bonds); final tax for individuals. Paid by payers of dividends and interest (withheld). D.L. 66/2014 art. 3.
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: investment-income

source.title: Normattiva: D.L. 24 aprile 2014, n. 66, art. 3 (redditi di natura finanziaria), testo vigente

rows.label: Rental income and pension income taxation (cedolare secca; pensioni) [national]
rows.value: optional flat tax on residential rent 21% (10% agreed rents; 26% from the second short-let property); pensions taxed as employment income under IRPEF. Paid by landlords and pensioners. D.Lgs. 23/2011 art. 3; TUIR art. 49.
rows.note: Checklist item A7; detailed table: rental-income

source.title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Cedolare secca, scheda informativa

rows.label: Employer levies: additional unemployment contribution on fixed-term contracts and dismissal levy (contributo addizionale NASpI; ticket di licenziamento) [national]
rows.value: 1.4% of pay on non-permanent contracts (+0.5 points per renewal); 41% of the monthly benefit maximum per 12 months of service on dismissal. Paid by employers. Legge 92/2012 art. 2 commi 28 and 31.
rows.note: Checklist item B2; detailed table: employer-levies

source.title: Normattiva: Legge 28 giugno 2012, n. 92, art. 2, commi 28 e 31, testo vigente

rows.label: Occupational pension: automatic enrolment into supplementary pension funds (adesione automatica alla previdenza complementare) [national]
rows.value: from 1 July 2026 first-time private-sector employees are enrolled with their whole TFR and the contractual contributions; 60-day opt-out. Paid by employers and employees. D.Lgs. 252/2005 art. 8; Legge 199/2025 art. 1 comma 202.
rows.note: Checklist item B4; detailed table: occupational-pension

source.title: Normattiva: D.Lgs. 5 dicembre 2005, n. 252 (previdenza complementare), art. 8, commi 7 to 7-quinquies, testo vigente

rows.label: Value added tax (IVA) [national]
rows.value: 22% standard; 10%, 5% and 4% reduced. Paid by consumers (charged by businesses). D.P.R. 633/1972 art. 16 and Tabella A.
rows.note: Checklist item D1; detailed table: vat

source.title: Normattiva: D.P.R. 26 ottobre 1972, n. 633 (IVA), art. 16 (aliquote dell'imposta), testo vigente

rows.label: Excise duties on motor fuels (accise sui prodotti energetici) [national]
rows.value: petrol and diesel €672.90 per 1,000 litres from 1 January 2026 (diesel cut temporarily during 2026). Paid by fuel suppliers (passed on in the price). D.Lgs. 504/1995 Allegato I; D.Lgs. 43/2025 art. 3.
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise

source.title: Normattiva: D.Lgs. 28 marzo 2025, n. 43, art. 3 (accise su benzine e gasolio), testo vigente

rows.label: Financial transaction tax (imposta sulle transazioni finanziarie) [national]
rows.value: 0.4% on transfers of Italian shares (0.2% on regulated markets); 0.04% on high-frequency trading. Paid by buyers of shares. Legge 228/2012 (legge di stabilità 2013) art. 1.
rows.note: Checklist item D4; detailed table: financial-transaction-tax

source.title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Imposta sulle transazioni finanziarie, che cos'è

rows.label: Digital services tax (imposta sui servizi digitali) [national]
rows.value: 3% of revenue from digital services in Italy, for groups with worldwide revenue of €750m or more. Paid by large digital companies. Legge 145/2018 art. 1.
rows.note: Checklist item D4; detailed table: digital-services-tax

source.title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Dichiarazione Imposta sui servizi digitali, che cos'è (imprese)

rows.label: Wealth tax on foreign assets: IVIE and IVAFE (imposta sul valore degli immobili all'estero; imposta sul valore delle attività finanziarie all'estero) [national]
rows.value: 1.06% of foreign real estate; 0.2% of foreign financial assets (0.4% in tax havens), €34.20 per foreign bank account. Paid by resident individuals with assets abroad. D.L. 201/2011 art. 19.
rows.note: Checklist item E3; detailed table: wealth-tax

source.title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Ivie, base imponibile e aliquota

rows.label: Inheritance tax (imposta di successione) [national]
rows.value: 4% above €1m per beneficiary for spouse and lineal relatives; 6% above €100,000 for siblings; 6% other relatives; 8% others. Paid by heirs. D.Lgs. 346/1990 art. 7.
rows.note: Checklist item E4; detailed table: inheritance

source.title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Imposta di successione, aliquote e franchigie

rows.label: Motor vehicle tax: regional car tax and the national supercar levy (tassa automobilistica; superbollo) [regional]
rows.value: regional car tax by kW and emission class; €20 per kW above 185 kW national surcharge. Paid by vehicle owners. addizionale erariale sulla tassa automobilistica (superbollo); regional car-tax rules.
rows.note: Checklist item F1; detailed table: vehicle-taxes

source.title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Addizionale erariale sulle tasse automobilistiche (superbollo), come, quando e quanto versare

rows.label: Environmental taxes on plastic and sweetened drinks (plastic tax; sugar tax) [national]
rows.value: not levied in 2026: deferred to 1 January 2027. Paid by manufacturers and importers (from 2027). Legge 160/2019 art. 1 commi 634-650 and 661-676; Legge 199/2025.
rows.note: Checklist item F2; detailed table: environmental-tax

source.title: Agenzia delle Dogane e dei Monopoli, Direzione Accise: Avviso 9 gennaio 2026, Sugar tax e plastic tax: rinvio al 1° gennaio 2027

rows.label: Tourist tax (imposta di soggiorno) [municipal]
rows.value: up to €5 per night where the municipality levies it (Rome up to €10); landing fee up to €2.50 on small islands. Paid by guests (collected by the accommodation). D.Lgs. 23/2011 art. 4; D.L. 78/2010 art. 14.
rows.note: Checklist item F3; detailed table: tourist-tax

source.title: Normattiva: D.Lgs. 14 marzo 2011, n. 23, art. 4 (imposta di soggiorno), testo vigente

rows.label: Air passenger boarding-fee levy (addizionale comunale sui diritti d'imbarco) [national]
rows.value: €6.50 per departing passenger (amount being checked). Paid by air passengers (collected with the ticket). Legge 350/2003 art. 2 comma 11.
rows.note: Checklist item F4; detailed table: air-passenger-tax

source.title: Gazzetta Ufficiale, 1ª Serie speciale Corte costituzionale, 15 maggio 2024: sentenza n. 80/2024 (addizionale comunale sui diritti d'imbarco)

rows.label: Customs, import VAT and traveller allowances (dogana, IVA all'importazione) [EU and national]
rows.value: EU Common Customs Tariff; EUR 150 duty relief until 30 June 2026, then EUR 3 per item; 22% import VAT; EUR 430 / 300 traveller allowance; EUR 10,000 cash declaration. Paid by importers and travellers. Regulations (EC) 1186/2009, (EU) 2026/382 and 2018/1672; Directive 2007/74/EC; D.P.R. 633/1972.
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs

rows.label: Stamp duties on documents (imposta di bollo) [national]
rows.value: €16 per sheet on applications and certificates (fixed stamp duty). Paid by the person filing or receiving the document. imposta di bollo (D.P.R. 642/1972, tariff).
rows.note: Checklist item H1; detailed table: stamp-duties

source.title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Attestazione situazione reddituale, costo (imposta di bollo)

rows.label: Broadcasting licence fee (canone TV) [national]
rows.value: €90 a year per household with a television, billed with electricity. Paid by households with a television. canone di abbonamento alla televisione (Agenzia delle Entrate).

rows.label: Property transfer tax: registration, mortgage and cadastral taxes [national]
rows.value: registration tax 9%, or 2% on a main home (minimum €1,000), plus €50 + €50; new homes from builders pay VAT at 4%, 10% or 22% plus €200 for each of the three fixed taxes. Paid by the buyer. DPR 131/1986 Tariffa parte prima art. 1; D.Lgs. 23/2011 art. 10; DPR 633/1972 tabella A. In force from 1 January 2014.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item A4
rows.source_title: Normattiva: Legge 20 maggio 1985, n. 222, art. 47 (otto per mille), testo vigente
rows.label: Church allocation from income tax (otto per mille) [national]
rows.value: no church tax; 0.8% of total IRPEF revenue is shared between the State and religious denominations according to taxpayers' choices. Paid by the State, out of IRPEF already due. Legge 222/1985 art. 47.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item A5; detailed table: capital-gains
rows.source_title: Normattiva: D.L. 24 aprile 2014, n. 66, art. 3 (redditi di natura finanziaria), testo vigente
rows.label: Capital gains tax on financial assets (imposta sostitutiva sui redditi diversi di natura finanziaria) [national]
rows.value: 26% (12.5% on government bonds; 33% on crypto-asset gains from 2026). Paid by individuals (usually withheld by the intermediary). D.L. 66/2014 art. 3; Legge 207/2024 art. 1 comma 24.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: investment-income
rows.source_title: Normattiva: D.L. 24 aprile 2014, n. 66, art. 3 (redditi di natura finanziaria), testo vigente
rows.label: Withholding on dividends and interest (ritenuta e imposta sostitutiva) [national]
rows.value: 26% (12.5% on government bonds); final tax for individuals. Paid by payers of dividends and interest (withheld). D.L. 66/2014 art. 3.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item A7; detailed table: rental-income
rows.source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Cedolare secca, scheda informativa
rows.label: Rental income and pension income taxation (cedolare secca; pensioni) [national]
rows.value: optional flat tax on residential rent 21% (10% agreed rents; 26% from the second short-let property); pensions taxed as employment income under IRPEF. Paid by landlords and pensioners. D.Lgs. 23/2011 art. 3; TUIR art. 49.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item B2; detailed table: employer-levies
rows.source_title: Normattiva: Legge 28 giugno 2012, n. 92, art. 2, commi 28 e 31, testo vigente
rows.label: Employer levies: additional unemployment contribution on fixed-term contracts and dismissal levy (contributo addizionale NASpI; ticket di licenziamento) [national]
rows.value: 1.4% of pay on non-permanent contracts (+0.5 points per renewal); 41% of the monthly benefit maximum per 12 months of service on dismissal. Paid by employers. Legge 92/2012 art. 2 commi 28 and 31.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item B4; detailed table: occupational-pension
rows.source_title: Normattiva: D.Lgs. 5 dicembre 2005, n. 252 (previdenza complementare), art. 8, commi 7 to 7-quinquies, testo vigente
rows.label: Occupational pension: automatic enrolment into supplementary pension funds (adesione automatica alla previdenza complementare) [national]
rows.value: from 1 July 2026 first-time private-sector employees are enrolled with their whole TFR and the contractual contributions; 60-day opt-out. Paid by employers and employees. D.Lgs. 252/2005 art. 8; Legge 199/2025 art. 1 comma 202.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item D1; detailed table: vat
rows.source_title: Normattiva: D.P.R. 26 ottobre 1972, n. 633 (IVA), art. 16 (aliquote dell'imposta), testo vigente
rows.label: Value added tax (IVA) [national]
rows.value: 22% standard; 10%, 5% and 4% reduced. Paid by consumers (charged by businesses). D.P.R. 633/1972 art. 16 and Tabella A.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise
rows.source_title: Normattiva: D.Lgs. 28 marzo 2025, n. 43, art. 3 (accise su benzine e gasolio), testo vigente
rows.label: Excise duties on motor fuels (accise sui prodotti energetici) [national]
rows.value: petrol and diesel €672.90 per 1,000 litres from 1 January 2026 (diesel cut temporarily during 2026). Paid by fuel suppliers (passed on in the price). D.Lgs. 504/1995 Allegato I; D.Lgs. 43/2025 art. 3.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item D4; detailed table: financial-transaction-tax
rows.source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Imposta sulle transazioni finanziarie, che cos'è
rows.label: Financial transaction tax (imposta sulle transazioni finanziarie) [national]
rows.value: 0.4% on transfers of Italian shares (0.2% on regulated markets); 0.04% on high-frequency trading. Paid by buyers of shares. Legge 228/2012 (legge di stabilità 2013) art. 1.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item D4; detailed table: digital-services-tax
rows.source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Dichiarazione Imposta sui servizi digitali, che cos'è (imprese)
rows.label: Digital services tax (imposta sui servizi digitali) [national]
rows.value: 3% of revenue from digital services in Italy, for groups with worldwide revenue of €750m or more. Paid by large digital companies. Legge 145/2018 art. 1.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item E3; detailed table: wealth-tax
rows.source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Ivie, base imponibile e aliquota
rows.label: Wealth tax on foreign assets: IVIE and IVAFE (imposta sul valore degli immobili all'estero; imposta sul valore delle attività finanziarie all'estero) [national]
rows.value: 1.06% of foreign real estate; 0.2% of foreign financial assets (0.4% in tax havens), €34.20 per foreign bank account. Paid by resident individuals with assets abroad. D.L. 201/2011 art. 19.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item E4; detailed table: inheritance
rows.source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Imposta di successione, aliquote e franchigie
rows.label: Inheritance tax (imposta di successione) [national]
rows.value: 4% above €1m per beneficiary for spouse and lineal relatives; 6% above €100,000 for siblings; 6% other relatives; 8% others. Paid by heirs. D.Lgs. 346/1990 art. 7.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item F1; detailed table: vehicle-taxes
rows.source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Addizionale erariale sulle tasse automobilistiche (superbollo), come, quando e quanto versare
rows.label: Motor vehicle tax: regional car tax and the national supercar levy (tassa automobilistica; superbollo) [regional]
rows.value: regional car tax by kW and emission class; €20 per kW above 185 kW national surcharge. Paid by vehicle owners. addizionale erariale sulla tassa automobilistica (superbollo); regional car-tax rules.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item F2; detailed table: environmental-tax
rows.source_title: Agenzia delle Dogane e dei Monopoli, Direzione Accise: Avviso 9 gennaio 2026, Sugar tax e plastic tax: rinvio al 1° gennaio 2027
rows.label: Environmental taxes on plastic and sweetened drinks (plastic tax; sugar tax) [national]
rows.value: not levied in 2026: deferred to 1 January 2027. Paid by manufacturers and importers (from 2027). Legge 160/2019 art. 1 commi 634-650 and 661-676; Legge 199/2025.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item F3; detailed table: tourist-tax
rows.source_title: Normattiva: D.Lgs. 14 marzo 2011, n. 23, art. 4 (imposta di soggiorno), testo vigente
rows.label: Tourist tax (imposta di soggiorno) [municipal]
rows.value: up to €5 per night where the municipality levies it (Rome up to €10); landing fee up to €2.50 on small islands. Paid by guests (collected by the accommodation). D.Lgs. 23/2011 art. 4; D.L. 78/2010 art. 14.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item F4; detailed table: air-passenger-tax
rows.source_title: Gazzetta Ufficiale, 1ª Serie speciale Corte costituzionale, 15 maggio 2024: sentenza n. 80/2024 (addizionale comunale sui diritti d'imbarco)
rows.label: Air passenger boarding-fee levy (addizionale comunale sui diritti d'imbarco) [national]
rows.value: €6.50 per departing passenger (amount being checked). Paid by air passengers (collected with the ticket). Legge 350/2003 art. 2 comma 11.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs
rows.source_title: EUR-Lex: Council Directive 2007/74/EC on the exemption from value added tax and excise duty of goods imported by persons travelling from third countries, Articles 7 to 11
rows.label: Customs, import VAT and traveller allowances (dogana, IVA all'importazione) [EU and national]
rows.value: EU Common Customs Tariff; EUR 150 duty relief until 30 June 2026, then EUR 3 per item; 22% import VAT; EUR 430 / 300 traveller allowance; EUR 10,000 cash declaration. Paid by importers and travellers. Regulations (EC) 1186/2009, (EU) 2026/382 and 2018/1672; Directive 2007/74/EC; D.P.R. 633/1972.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item H1; detailed table: stamp-duties
rows.source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Attestazione situazione reddituale, costo (imposta di bollo)
rows.label: Stamp duties on documents (imposta di bollo) [national]
rows.value: €16 per sheet on applications and certificates (fixed stamp duty). Paid by the person filing or receiving the document. imposta di bollo (D.P.R. 642/1972, tariff).

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item H2; detailed table: tv-licence
rows.source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Canone TV, come si paga
rows.label: Broadcasting licence fee (canone TV) [national]
rows.value: €90 a year per household with a television, billed with electricity. Paid by households with a television. canone di abbonamento alla televisione (Agenzia delle Entrate).
